technique_name: Explain why climate change is a pressing environmental and human concern.
description: Climate change is a pressing environmental and human concern because it poses a threat to the livelihoods of countless people and ecosystems. Temperature increases resulting from climate change have the potential to cause droughts, floods, and other extreme weather conditions that can lead to water shortages, crop failures, and famine.
